Description
Drew University is a popular choice for international students looking to be part of an intimate and nurturing setting. The university's one-on-one approach to learning ensures that students are never lost in the crowd. Whatever their academic and professional interests, our degrees prepare them for the future—from Ivy League graduate school to in-demand careers such as data analytics and finance.70% of classes have fewer than 20 students50-minute train ride from NYC90% of the student population lives on campusZero classes taught by graduate assistants; students learn directly from professors
